info.title: Owner financial summary
info.description: Implemented read-only full-scope summary. Frozen invoice rent allocated by coverage month, invoice cohort by period, receipts by actual paidAt in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh, current all-period arrears and current inventory. No net-profit or historical occupancy claim.

parameters.name: propertyId
parameters.description: Omit for all currently owned properties. Foreign/nonexistent ID returns 404.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Default current server year in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh.

200.description: Full year: 12 ordered months, exact decimal strings, no page/size. SENT only. Paid invoice face value is grouped by billing period, actual invoice-payment amount and exact-party additional receipt amount by paidAt calendar year. Manual cashbook/cọc/refunds/withdrawals are separate and not added. Current payment status applies even to prior invoice years; this is not a historical year-end snapshot.

Error.description: Input/authentication/eligible Owner/property scope error. Errors must not become zero or sample data.

Money.description: Exact decimal amount; client converts only chart axes to approximate million VND.

onTimePaidInvoiceCount.description: Among paid invoices of this invoice cohort: paidAt Vietnam date <= dueDate. Ratio denominator is paidInvoiceCount, never all unpaid/future invoices; no paid invoices means unavailable, not 100%.

Arrears.description: Current unpaid records across all years. Monthly invoices are overdue only if dueDate<server today. Additional receipts have no dueDate policy and are not classified overdue.

Inventory.description: Current owned Apartment records, including unpublished inventory. OCCUPIED and VACANT states, no annual historical-occupancy inference or contracted-rent revenue fallback.

allocatedRentAmount.description: Rent from SENT invoices allocated across covered calendar months in the selected year. Independent of paidAt; excludes utility fees/additional receipts. Missing legacy coverage uses invoice period. Four-decimal split with exact remainder in final coverage month.
